text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Thirty vessels laden with food to dock at Iraq's Umm Qasr port in a few days.
- Chinese companies express readiness to implement telecommunication projects in Iraq.
- Iraq and Malaysia discuss means of enhancing bilateral ties.
- A United Arab Emirates newspaper calls for an Arab summit to support Iraq and the Palestinian state.
